propositions: Shell probe-rebar.sh accumulated stale assertions and must be ported to Python while preserving continue-on-failure semantics (collect results, report all, exit non-zero if any failed).
All 140 shell probe assertions must be inventoried and carried over or explicitly retired with justification to prevent silent drift.
Consumers across workflows (test.yml, gerrit-verify.yaml, external-integration.yml), anti-rot tests, and docs must be re-pointed atomically to the Python entry point in the same change.
Shell script must be retained as a transitional 7-line exec shim to support gerrit-verify.yaml executing from main's workflow definition until shim deletion is completed in a follow-up change.
Side-by-side parity run must confirm identical pass/fail verdicts and assertion counts before shell script deletion.
